chinese: 语气委婉的选项更可能正确
english: Options with a moderate tone are more likely to be correct
soundmark: /ˈɒpʃənz wɪð ə ˈmɒdərət toʊn ɑːr mɔːr ˈlaɪkli tuː biː kəˈrekt/

chinese: 绝对词出现百分之九十九是错误选项
english: Absolute words appear in ninety nine percent of wrong options
soundmark: /ˈæbsəluːt wɜːrdz əˈpɪər ɪn ˈnaɪnti naɪn pərˈsent ɒv rɒŋ ˈɒpʃənz/

chinese: 原文没有明确比较选项出现比较级就是错的
english: If the original text has no explicit comparison an option with a comparative is wrong
soundmark: /ɪf ðə əˈrɪdʒɪnəl tekst hæz noʊ ɪkˈsplɪsɪt kəmˈpærɪsən ən ˈɒpʃən wɪð ə kəmˈpærətɪv ɪz rɒŋ/

chinese: 无中生有原文没提常识对也算错
english: If the original text does not mention it then it is wrong even if common sense agrees
soundmark: /ɪf ðə əˈrɪdʒɪnəl tekst dʌz nɒt ˈmenʃən ɪt ðen ɪt ɪz rɒŋ ˈiːvən ɪf ˈkɒmən sens əˈɡriːz/
